__fixture: attachment/deferred_tools_delta at session start - the tool roster, including every MCP tool.
__key_facts: addedNames[] holds tool ids. MCP tools appear as mcp__<server>__<tool>; plugin-bundled ones as mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>.
pendingMcpServers[] names servers still CONNECTING at this point - their tools are NOT yet in addedNames. This is why the session-start MCP roster is incomplete.
pendingMcpServers uses the display form plugin:<plugin>:<server>, NOT the tool form mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__. Two naming conventions for one server.
There is no isInitial flag on this record type.
